en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, two‑storey classical building with simple neoclassical detailing and a triangular pediment at the near end. The structure fronts a tree‑lined promenade or park with footpaths, benches, small kiosks and dense greenery. Low‑rise buildings extend into the distance under an open sky, giving the impression of a smaller historic town. There is a broad white border around the photograph, typical of early‑ to mid‑20th‑century postcards.
